ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food chain diagram below, which animal would most directly lack food if Grasshoppers get exterminated?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows plants on the left and animals connected by arrows. The labeled Grasshopper is near the lower middle of the diagram, and the labeled Frog is just to its right/lower-right. An arrow/link goes from Grasshopper toward Frog, indicating the Frog directly eats the Grasshopper. Reasoning: If Grasshoppers were exterminated, the animal that most directly depends on them as food would lose that food source first. Since the diagram shows the Frog directly eating the Grasshopper, Frogs would most directly lack food.
